title: Companies (Amendment) Regulations, S.R.O.57 of 2002
text:
COMPANIES (AMENDMENT)
REGULATIONS
MADE by the Minister under section 527 of the Companies Act
(No. 21 of 1994).
(Gazetted 14thNovember. 2002.)
1. These Regulations may be cited as the -
COMPANIES (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2002.
2. In these Regulations the Companies Regulations. 1997
are referred to as "the Principal Regulations".
3. Regulation 27 of the Principal Regulations isamended by
inserting the following new subregulations immediately after
subregulation (5):
" (6) The annual company fee payable under
section 9A of the Act shall be as follows:
(a) for a company whose share
capital does not exceed
$49,999 $200.00
(b) for a company with a share
capital from $50,000 to
$100,000 $500.00
(c) for a company with a share
capital from $100,001
to $200,000 $700.00
(d)for every additional $100,000
of share capital over
$200,000 or part thereof $100.00

COMPANIES (AMENDMENT)
REGULATIONS
(7) A non-profit company shall be exempt from
payment of the annual company fee prescribed in
subregulation (6)."
